sources.citation: ARMD — Antibiotic Resistance Microbiology Dataset, Stanford Health Care (~970k cultures, ~15 yrs). Nature Scientific Data (2025).

meta.notes: Auto-generated from the ARMD cohort by build_us_armd_antibiogram.py. In the US path the RF model drives ranking; this antibiogram drives the FILTER (tested pairs >= CLSI M39 threshold) and supplies US %-susceptible for the US-vs-PK contrast chart. Keys are normalised snake_case and must share the vocabulary used by pakistan.json and the model (see README).
